name: Source Tag
description: LOW CORNER. The citation for a fact: 'SOURCE: NOAA, 2024' in white tracked caps on a small dark glass chip, one thin rule in the brand accent down its corner edge (label = 'Source'; text = the source as said, or the short form viewers know; subtitle = the year, only when the narration or the research gives it). In under 250 ms (a fade and a 14 px slide from its corner), out quicker (167 ms). align left / right picks the corner; with captions on it sits clear above them. Silent. Placed only by the planner's source pass (src/sources.py, ON_SCREEN_SOURCES / SOURCE_TAGS): a source the narration names, or the script's own research for a fact the line states - never invented; a figure with no known source gets no tag.
